description: Research-only ordered point-in-time-safe tree selector allowlist containing the parent 29-feature schema minus eight date-level market-context features.

exclusions.name: market_momentum_20d
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; unsuitable for cross-sectional tree routing.

exclusions.name: market_momentum_60d
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; selected in upper tree splits that routed the OOS universe identically.

exclusions.name: market_momentum_120d
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; selected at the expanding random-forest root.

exclusions.name: market_volatility_20d
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; selected in upper tree splits that routed the OOS universe identically.

exclusions.name: market_drawdown_60d
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; selected in upper random-forest and gradient-boosting splits.

exclusions.name: market_distance_from_200d_average
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; unsuitable for cross-sectional tree routing.

exclusions.name: market_trend_state
exclusions.reason: One shared state for every stock on a decision date; unsuitable for cross-sectional tree routing.

exclusions.name: market_volatility_percentile
exclusions.reason: One shared value for every stock on a decision date; selected in rolling-window upper tree splits.

exclusion_rationale: These market-context fields are identical for every stock within a decision-date cross-section and caused shallow tree upper splits to route every OOS stock identically.
